mapper.insert: INSERT INTO messages (message_id, conversation_id, sender_user_id, sender_type, client_message_id, content, status, created_at) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{conversationId}, #{senderUserId}, #{senderType}, #{clientMessageId}, #{content}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}::message_status, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT message_id, conversation_id, sender_user_id, client_message_id, content, status, created_at FROM messages WHERE message_id = #{messageId} LIMIT 1

select * from ( select message_id, conversation_id, sender_user_id, sender_type, client_message_id, content, status, created_at from messages where conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by created_at desc limit #{limit} ) t order by created_at asc

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT message_id, conversation_id, sender_user_id, client_message_id, content, created_at, status, sender_type FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND sender_type = 'USER' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) t ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT message_id, conversation_id, sender_user_id, client_message_id, content, status, created_at FROM messages WHERE sender_user_id = #{senderUserId} AND client_message_id = #{clientMessageId} LIMIT 1
